citations.text: Y. Feyman, A. Legler, K. N. Griffith (2021). Appointment wait time data for primary & specialty care in Veterans Health Administration facilities vs. community medical centers. Data in Brief 36, 107134.

description: Aggregated appointment waiting days by county, month and clinic stop code for Veterans Health Administration and Community Care.
name: US Veterans Health Administration appointment wait times

recipe.reason: The county-level file is one download of 14,365,643 rows, more cells than a fetch can hold even for the id alone, and a recipe streams only a paged source, since a single file is downloaded whole before it is read; 8,264 of its rows also have unquoted commas in the state and county names of the armed forces entries, which the csv-table parser refuses at line 1892.
